sources.title: Distilled Models | deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope This page documents the distilled model variants in the DeepSeek-R1 family. These models are smaller, more efficient versions that preserve the reasoning capabilities of the full-sized DeepSeek-R1 model. This document covers the distillation process, available model variants, performance benchmarks, and deployment options.
